pins.title: Fall Weekend Trip from DC: Virginia's Northern Neck in September
pins.description: A fall weekend trip from DC, under 3 hours south. September on Virginia's Northern Neck means warm creek water, the best crabbing of the year, and the quiet after summer.
pins.altText: An osprey perched at the top of a bare, silvery snag above Chesapeake water, with green shoreline trees below.

pins.title: Chesapeake Bay Fall Getaway: Why September Beats Summer
pins.description: Why a Chesapeake Bay fall getaway beats summer: the restaurant lines thin out, crabs are at their biggest, and the water is still warm enough to swim in September.
pins.altText: A cedar-sided hot tub with steps on a stone patio, beside the cottage with a tidal creek and tree line beyond, in soft light.

pins.title: Virginia Waterfront Fall Weekend: Northern Neck Ospreys and Crabs
pins.description: Planning a Virginia waterfront fall weekend? Late-season ospreys still fish the creek in September, crabbing peaks, and the hot tub is best on a cool night.
pins.altText: Top half: an osprey on a bare snag over the water. Bottom half: a hot tub on a patio beside the cottage.
